visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace the Magic Numbers
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The table works but the numbers 3 and 5 are written again and again. Use named values so the table can be changed in one place. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Named constants say what each number means and let you change the table by editing a single line instead of hunting for every 3 and 5.
